_readme: TEMPLATE, NOT A REAL VENUE'S RULES. Copy this file, rename it, replace the numbers with the ones YOUR venue's own guidelines state (and cite them in `source`), then run `set-venue <id> --profile <file>`. The numbers below are illustrative placeholders.
label: Example Journal
description: Illustrative venue profile used by the documentation and the test suite. It exercises the fields the other shipped profiles do not: a published figure-legend limit, no cover-letter preference, and an explicit journal list. The numbers are placeholders, not a real journal's requirements.

article_types.label: Research Article
article_types.source: Example Journal guidelines for Research Articles (illustrative placeholder)

length_limits.source: Example Journal guidelines for Research Articles (illustrative placeholder: abstract <= 250 words; main text <= 5,000 words excluding abstract, references and figure legends)

cover_letter.source: the Example Journal guidelines state no cover-letter word limit and this profile configures no preference

captions.source: Example Journal guidelines (illustrative placeholder: each figure legend is limited to 250 words)

article_types.label: Review
article_types.source: Example Journal guidelines for Reviews (illustrative placeholder)

length_limits.source: Example Journal guidelines for Reviews (illustrative placeholder: abstract <= 200 words; main text <= 8,000 words)

article_types.label: Letter to the Editor
article_types.source: Example Journal guidelines for Letters (illustrative placeholder)

length_limits.source: Example Journal guidelines for Letters (illustrative placeholder: no abstract; main text <= 800 words)

submission.pdf_note: Example Journal accepts PDF initial submissions (illustrative placeholder), and a reader or editor may open exactly that PDF

tables.source: illustrative placeholder (this profile's numbers and rules are placeholders, not a real journal's requirements)
tables.note: Illustrative: a table follows the rule unless the entry below matches it.
tables.caption: before

special.caption: none
special.note: shows how a publisher's key-resources table stays inside its methods, uncaptioned, without the numbered-table rule being applied to it

figures.source: illustrative placeholder (this profile's numbers and rules are placeholders, not a real journal's requirements)
figures.note: Illustrative: figure legends are collected at the end of the manuscript, and the graphical abstract is a front-matter item that is not part of the numbered figure sequence.
figures.caption: any

special.caption: none
special.note: shows how a front-matter figure -- a graphical abstract, a graphical table of contents -- is exempted from the numbered-figure caption/placement rule instead of being renumbered or moved

prompt.subject: an Example Journal research-article submission
prompt.editor: an Example Journal editor or reviewer
prompt.requirements: the Example Journal author guidelines and submission requirements
prompt.guidelines_source: the Example Journal author guidelines (illustrative placeholder -- replace with your venue's own)
